picks.title: Zyxel fixes zero-day exploited to hack nearly 1,000 network switches
picks.summary: Zyxel has patched a zero-day vulnerability in its GS1900 series network switches that hackers exploited to compromise nearly 1,000 devices worldwide and steal configuration files and credentials. [...]

picks.title: PHP vulnerability post-mortem reveals bug was known two years ago — Small team of maintainers knew of the issue before it was made public, as new PHP2Shell chained exploit ravages servers
picks.summary: PHP has a harvest season to remember — AI-automated bug hunting reaps what years of technical debt have sown.

picks.title: NIKKE PC game launcher hacked to spread remote access, data-stealing malware
picks.summary: The developers of Goddess of Victory: NIKKE have confirmed that hackers tampered with the game s PC launcher scripts in a supply-chain attack, distributing malware capable of stealing credentials and cryptocurrency wallet data. [...]

picks.title: CISA flags WordPress RCE flaw as actively exploited in attacks
picks.summary: The US Cybersecurity and Infrastructure Security Agency (CISA) warned federal agencies that attackers have started exploiting a recently patched high-severity WordPress vulnerability in the wild. [...]

picks.title: GITBOOK CONFIRMS INFRASTRUCTURE BREACH BEHIND DOCUMENTATION INCIDENT; TRADE.XYZ SAYS ITS SYSTEMS WERE UNAFFECTED
Coinbase says 99% of customer assets sit in cold storage after Binance’s $6.3 billion breach
picks.summary: Coinbase says 99% of customer assets are in cold storage and it wasn t affected by the $6.3 billion Binance hack.

picks.title: DreamHost confirms data breach exposed FTP logins and webmail sessions
picks.summary: DreamHost is warning of a data breach after attackers gained access to its File Manager platform for two months and stole customers FTP/SFTP usernames and passwords. [...]

picks.title: Coinbase Says 99% of Customer Crypto Is Offline and Out of Hackers’ Reach
picks.summary: Coinbase told customers it wasn’t affected by the $6.4 billion Binance hack and detailed its security controls, including offline storage for over 99% of assets, split private keys and kill switches.

picks.title: Bitcoin rebounds past $80,000 as markets shrug off midterms and Binance hack
picks.summary: Bitcoin rose 3.5% to $80,500 and ether jumped 6% after Democrats won Congress, while Bitwise says the Binance hack had limited market impact.

picks.title: Privacy Cash Pauses Deposits After Binance Hack
picks.summary: Elliptic traced about $1.2 million in theft-linked ETH and SOL into its pools; the team says withdrawals remain open.

picks.title: Binance Expands Proof of Reserves to 44 Tokens After Hack
picks.summary: The exchange says it has replenished about 98% of affected assets, but the new cryptographic proof is unfinished and withdrawals are not fully reopened.
